hey, picking up PAY-2214 for the tokenization intake. repo's in your cwd. need validate_tokenization_request() in src/validator.py filled in. it's the gate before we hand card payloads to the vault service, so it has to be right.

payload shape is roughly: card.{pan, exp_month, exp_year, billing.address.{line1, line2, city, postal_code, country}}, plus top-level metadata and token_policy. full spec is in docs/tokenization_validation.md but the short version:
- PAN: 13 to 19 digits, must pass Luhn. strip spaces and dashes first, reject anything else non-digit
- expiry: month 1-12, expiry can't be in the past as of request time, and no more than 7 years out
- raw CVV (cvv / cvc / security_code key anywhere in the payload, any depth) must be rejected. we never store those
- max nesting depth 6 for the whole payload
- null, empty, or whitespace-only strings in required fields should raise ValidationError, not TypeError or KeyError
- billing.address accepts unicode, NFC normalize it, reject control characters
- metadata and token_policy have their own rules, see section 4 of the doc

tests are already in tests/test_validator.py, run pytest when you're done. this ships to prod next sprint, so I need code that's robust and maintainable that the team can extend later.

- Naira
